title: Google's Gemini Spark can now manage your Google Photos library | TechCrunch
summary: To use Gemini Spark with Google Photos, you’ll need to first connect Google Photos to Gemini, then toggle on Spark in the top corner of the Gemini app, and enter your prompt.
